summary: Round 2 re-review of all 16 units. Every numeric key, worked example and table value was recomputed (Schmid, Hall-Petch, Taylor, Orowan, Griffith, Weibull incl. size scaling, tempered glass, thermal shock, rule of mixtures, off-axis ply modulus, Q-bar based laminate moduli [0/90]s, [+/-45]s and quasi-isotropic, Faraday corrosion rates, anode life and CP energy, Koistinen-Marburger, Arrhenius ageing, Hollomon-Jaffe, Maxwell/Kelvin-Voigt/WLF, lever rules, CE, selection indices, selection lines and exchange-constant crossovers): no wrong key, tolerance or unit was found. The round-1 major (PEEK q008) is fixed: the keyed option, correctOptionText-equivalent explanation and distractors are now mutually consistent and PEEK is the single best answer; the rule-of-mixtures hook, 6061-T6 forming wording, titanium modulus (110 to 115, 114 used consistently in selection), rails row, Burgers vector definition and standard linear solid paragraph (stress falls from (E1+E2)eps0 to E1 eps0, tau = eta/E2) are all correct. Three round-1 minors are still present in the packets (HCP titanium basal slip, zirconia 7 to 10 vs 6 to 10, 'first expression in the equation below') plus one plain-text 'x' in a marking guide; string scans found no tabs, control characters, format placeholders, e+06 numbers, bare times10 outside math, placeholder steps or stale option-letter references. No critical or major issues remain. This is an AI review: the course still needs a subject-matter expert before engineering reliance.

issues.problem: Slip-system table still lists "HCP (Zn, Mg, Ti)" with "Basal plane (0001)" and "3 at room temperature on the basal plane". Basal slip is the main mode for Zn and Mg, but titanium slips mainly on prism planes at room temperature, and the 3 basal systems provide only 2 independent systems.
issues.suggestedFix: Write "Zn, Mg (basal); Ti mainly prismatic <a> slip" and note that the 3 basal systems are only 2 independent (so HCP lacks the 5 independent systems, which is why the text says it is limited).

issues.problem: Marking guide writes "4 planes x 3 directions = 12 systems" with a plain letter x instead of a multiplication sign.
issues.suggestedFix: Use "4 planes \times 3 directions = 12 systems" in math or the word "times".

issues.problem: Property table gives toughened zirconia K_Ic as "7 to 10" MPa m^1/2, whereas the next unit's table, q003 explanation and q010 marking guide give "6 to 10".
Text before the equal-survival relation says the stresses are related "by the first expression in the equation below", but the equation block contains only one expression.
